regions.name: Conch Reef
regions.description: Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary — includes Conch Reef SPA and adjacent Research Only Area (Aquarius).

sites.name: Aquarius Reef Base
sites.locality: Conch Reef, Key Largo / Islamorada, Florida Keys
sites.description: World's only undersea research laboratory (FIU), on the seafloor at ~19 m next to Conch Reef in FKNMS. The Conch Reef Research Only Area is closed to public diving, snorkeling, and fishing; access is limited to authorized scientific / aquanaut missions (including historical NEEMO). Nearby recreational Conch Reef SPA sites are separate atlas entries.

properties.atlas_note: Included as a place in the undersea atlas; not a recreational charter site.

sites.name: Jules' Undersea Lodge
sites.locality: Key Largo Undersea Park, Florida Keys
sites.description: Underwater hotel in a lagoon at Key Largo Undersea Park (formerly marketed as Jules' Undersea Lab on PADI Travel). Guests scuba in; the lodge is famous for underwater pizza delivery to aquanaut overnight stays. Recreational / tourist access via the park — distinct from FIU Aquarius Reef Base on Conch Reef.

properties.atlas_note: Recreational undersea lodge; not a research habitat.
properties.lore: Underwater pizza delivery to overnight guests.
